name: Grade 6 T3 Practice: December Week 3 - Demonstrate and Explain
description: Practice words for demonstrating and explaining the final project.

words.definition: Information or an action that goes into a device or program.
words.example: A button press is an input.

words.definition: What a device does or shows after a program runs.
words.example: A sound can be an output.

words.definition: A rule that must be true for something to happen.
words.example: The condition checks for an object.

words.definition: A named place that stores a changing value.

words.example: We improve the route after testing.

words.definition: To make an idea clear with words.
words.example: Students explain what their robot does.
